summary: WVDNR's District 3 WMA page and the WMA map read: the DNR says only 'Camping in designated areas only' and never says where; its map (July 26, 2018 edition) has a legend of Gate and Parking only and marks no campsites. Nothing new to record; existing reported/derived values left.
flags: Missing agency website: WVDNR's page for the WMA is the District 3 list, https://wvdnr.gov/lands-waters/wildlife-management-areas/district-3-wildlife-management-areas/ (entry '36. Becky Creek'); map https://wvdnr.gov/wmamapproj/pdf/pdf150/BeckysCreekFinal11x17_150dpi.pdf. No phone on file; the page gives none for the WMA (District 3 office not listed there).

Criteria (AWH wildlife-agency rule): the DNR page says only 'On the WMA: Camping in designated areas only.' and its map's legend shows only 'Gate' and 'Parking' with no campsites marked, so the designated areas appear to be the hunter parking lots - a parking-lot camping allowance, not agency-designated campsites. Access: 'Several stream crossings can limit access during high water.' Looks like a drop under feedback_wildlife_agency_camping unless someone can show designated campsites.
